$comment: Curated free OpenAI-compatible brains for AAROHI. Anonymous entries need NO key. Never invent API keys.

aarohi_wiring.usage_order: MAIN + fallbacks; 401/429 on openai-compat → clear bad key / rotate anonymous / next card
aarohi_wiring.auto_default: FREE_LLM_PRESET=llm7 anonymous (empty key, model turbo). OVH anonymous is failover.
aarohi_wiring.local_only: ollama-local requires PC Ollama; not reachable from Vercel

notes: Without any keys, AAROHI wakes on LLM7 anonymous then OVH anonymous. Optional free-tier keys raise limits.

presets.label: LLM7.io (free / anonymous)
presets.notes: Anonymous: leave key EMPTY, use model turbo. A revoked key causes 401 - AAROHI clears it and retries.

presets.label: OVHcloud AI Endpoints (anonymous)
presets.notes: No Authorization header. Low RPM (~2/IP). Used as free failover when LLM7 quotas or keys fail.

presets.label: Groq (free tier)
presets.notes: Free key, no card. Ultra-fast. Built-in Groq card on Models.

presets.label: Google Gemini (free tier)
presets.notes: Free key from AI Studio. Built-in Gemini card.

presets.label: OpenRouter free pool
presets.notes: Free models with :free suffix. Needs a free OpenRouter account key.

presets.label: Aion Labs (roleplay / storytelling)
presets.notes: 15 RPM / 20K TPD free. Good companion models.

presets.label: Mistral AI (free mode)
presets.notes: Free mode key from Mistral console.

presets.label: Ollama (local, free)
presets.notes: Local only. Vercel cannot reach localhost Ollama.
